models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.why: Apple's MLX toolkit runs Meta's 816B-parameter open-weight model across Mac Studios over Thunderbolt 5/RDMA: ~25 gen tok/s on two 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios and 36+ tok/s on four, with time-to-first-token of 4.8s at an 8K prompt and 40.6s at 65K.

engines.hardware: 2x Mac Studio M5 Ultra, 512GB each (1TB unified memory across two machines, Thunderbolt 5 + RDMA; Apple measured ~25 generated tok/s, four-machine setup 36+; 8K prompt first token 4.8s, 65K prompt 40.6s)
